bio.lead: Your audience decides in 1.7 seconds. I engineer every frame so they stay, trust your brand, and act.
paragraphs: 8+ years, 500+ shipped cuts, and 100+ client shoots out of Jaipur — trusted by Chaayos, Mahanagar Times, and MLA Dr. Gopal Sharma.

points: Directed cinematic shoots and commercial productions from initial concept to final master delivery.
